channel.title: noisonnoiton (English)
channel.description: Platform Engineering, Kubernetes, and ModelOps field notes

item.title: Envoy Gateway Requests Timing Out After 15 Seconds: HTTPRoute and BackendTrafficPolicy
item.description: Diagnose 504 and upstream request timeout errors in Envoy Gateway, then configure HTTPRoute and BackendTrafficPolicy limits. Covers policy precedence, differences from AKS Istio ingress, and idle timeouts for streaming.

item.title: GitHub Actions Secret Theft: Attack Patterns, Investigation, and Response
item.description: How GitHub Actions secrets get stolen, told through tj-actions, Shai-Hulud, GhostAction, Gheist and a case I went through myself, followed by how to check whether your repositories were hit and what to do in which order.

item.title: Finding and Removing Secrets from Git History: gitleaks and git filter-repo
item.description: How to scan a repository's whole history for secrets with gitleaks, rotate what you find, and then remove it from history with git filter-repo. Covers values that gitleaks finds by decoding base64, old values that survive in a renamed directory, and how to prove the latest code did not change.

item.title: Claude Code skills and hooks: from the concepts to project rules in practice
item.description: Explains CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks, subagents, and two meanings of loop, then examines migration protection and Java formatting in a personal shopping project, including their limits and observed tests.

item.title: A one-line fix for senpi: the herdr sidebar agent-label bug
item.description: Tracing a herdr sidebar label back to senpi's builtin reporter, then submitting a branded-command fix with regression tests, a change fragment, and isolated real-CLI QA.

item.title: Fixes from Running a Starlight Blog: A Hand-Kept List, Empty Share Cards, and a Font That Never Loaded
item.description: Problems found and fixed on this Astro and Starlight blog: a noindex list that had to be edited for every new post, share metadata overwritten by the config head, a font that was declared but never loaded, and the work still left, covered with code and measured values.

item.title: Splitting Coding Agents by Role and Repository with herdr
item.description: How I split coding agents by repository, role and machine on top of the terminal workspace manager herdr. Covers one session per repository exchanging requests through inter-session messages, builder and reviewer sessions reviewing every document stage, a local Mac agent and a cloud VM agent exchanging work through herdr and outbox files, what agent prompt --wait really means, and the problems I hit.

item.title: Disabling KServe HTTPRoute Generation to Route Models by a Single Host and Path
item.description: How we turned off per-InferenceService HTTPRoute generation in KServe v0.19's Gateway API mode, managed HTTPRoutes ourselves so every model is called by path under one host, and what changes in KServe's behavior when you do, checked against the source.

item.title: Before Upgrading to OpenCode 2: Assessing Migration for a Plugin-Based Agent Environment
item.description: Inspecting OpenCode 2 compatibility, the oh-my-openagent maintainer's V2 support policy, and asset portability, with the rationale for using OmO Native as the primary tool while retaining V1 as a fallback and the installation and migration pitfalls observed.

item.title: Adding Authentication to Kubernetes Admin UIs with an nginx Sidecar
item.description: Put an nginx Basic Auth Sidecar in front of admin UIs that have no login of their own (NATS NUI, Valkey Admin), and reduce bypass paths by switching the Service targetPort and binding the app to loopback.
